title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 11: traditions held firm, head coverings, divisions at the meal, and the bread and the cup delivered to them.

questions.text: Why does the writer praise them in verse 2?
questions.explanation: The verse says he praises them because they remember him in all things and hold firm the traditions, even as he delivered them.

answers.text: Because they gather together every day of the week
Because they had settled all of their lawsuits
Because they remember him and hold firm the traditions
Because they had sent him a gift for his journey

questions.text: According to verse 3, who is the head of Christ?
questions.explanation: The verse says the head of every man is Christ, the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

answers.text: The assembly
God
The man
No one

questions.text: What does verse 6 say a woman should do if it is shameful for her hair to be cut off or shaved?
questions.explanation: The verse says that if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

answers.text: Let her keep silent
Let her stay at home
Let her hair be cut off anyway
Let her be covered

questions.text: Why does verse 7 say a man ought not to have his head covered?
questions.explanation: The verse says it is because he is the image and glory of God, while the woman is the glory of the man.

answers.text: Because he is the image and glory of God
Because nature teaches him so
Because of the angels
Because of the traditions

questions.text: What does verse 12 say about all things?
questions.explanation: The verse says that as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman, but all things are from God.

answers.text: All things are from the assembly
All things are from the law
All things are from God
All things are from the fathers

questions.text: According to verse 15, what is a woman's long hair?
questions.explanation: The verse says that if a woman has long hair it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

answers.text: A dishonor to her, as it is to a man
A glory to her, given to her for a covering
A sign given to those who do not believe
A custom kept only among the Gentiles

questions.text: What does verse 21 say happens in their eating?
questions.explanation: The verse says each one takes his own supper first, so that one is hungry and another is drunken.

answers.text: Each one takes his own supper first, so one is hungry and another drunken
They all wait until the very last one has come in
They eat only bread and drink only water together
They send all of the food to those who have nothing

questions.text: What does verse 23 say the Lord Jesus did on the night in which he was betrayed?
questions.explanation: The verse says that on the night in which he was betrayed he took bread, and verse 24 adds that he gave thanks and broke it.

answers.text: He washed the feet of his disciples
He went out to pray alone
He sent two of them into the city
He took bread, gave thanks and broke it

questions.text: According to verse 25, what did he say the cup is?
questions.explanation: The verse says he took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood."

answers.text: A sharing of the bread
The cup of blessing of the fathers
The new covenant in his blood
A sign to the unbelieving

questions.text: What does verse 33 tell them to do when they come together to eat?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "when you come together to eat, wait for one another."

answers.text: Wait for one another
Choose one man to give thanks for all
Sing a psalm before eating
Let the elders eat first
